user.title: Configure entity claims
user.description:
Create one logical claim per requester. Enter one requester per line as `requester_id: Requester name`. Leave the field empty to configure zero requesters.

{error_detail}

data_description.target_entity_id: The original entity whose actual state will be controlled.
data_description.requesters: Stable lowercase ID followed by a user-visible name, one per line.
data_description.aggregation_policy: How the current Boolean claims are combined.
data_description.diagnostic_sensor_enabled: Adds one read-only diagnostic sensor for this source.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure entity claims
reconfigure.description:
Source entity: `{target_entity_id}`. Add, remove, or rename requesters using `requester_id: Requester name`. Keep an ID unchanged when only renaming a requester.

{error_detail}

data_description.requesters: Removing a line removes its Claim Entity. An empty field means zero requesters.
data_description.aggregation_policy: How the current Boolean claims are combined.
data_description.diagnostic_sensor_enabled: Adds or removes the read-only diagnostic sensor.

error.target_not_found: The selected source entity is not currently available.
error.unsupported_domain: Only fan, light, and switch source entities are currently supported.
error.claim_cannot_be_target: A Claim Entity cannot be managed as a source entity.
error.invalid_requesters: The requester declarations or generated entity IDs are invalid. See the detail above.
error.entity_id_conflict: A generated Entity ID is already occupied. The conflicting ID is shown above; remove or rename that entity and try again.

abort.already_configured: This source entity is already managed by Entity Claim.

options.any: ANY — at least one claim is on
options.all: ALL — every configured claim is on
